question: What is the minimum age required for the appointment of a person as a governor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**35 years.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Governor of an Indian state** generally **holds office for a period of 5 years.**
 
• The Governor of the state is similar (not the same) to the President of the Union.
 
• ** Article 157 and Article 158** of the Constitution of India specify eligibility requirements for the post of gov
